title: /.well-known/swarm-evidence bundle (v1)
description: Shape of the attestation bundle the Swarm Cloud platform publishes for a router endpoint hostname. Mirrors swarm-cloud libs/swarm-attestation/src/types.ts (AttestationBundle) and its validateBundleShape(). The gatekeeper and the router's evidence poller validate shape against this schema; only the gatekeeper verifies signatures.

kind.description: Confidential Router endpoints publish DeploymentEvidence; the gatekeeper rejects the other kinds.

hostname.description: Must equal the hostname the bundle was fetched from.

certFingerprint.description: sha256/<base64url> of the DER of the TLS leaf served on this host.

jws.description: Compact JWS (RS256 or ES256K) over the evidence payload, signed by the chain's leaf key.

certChain.description: PEM certificates leaf → root; the terminal root must match a trusted root.

tlsLeaf.description: Optional leaf PEM for verifiers without channel access; the gatekeeper ignores it.

deploymentEvidencePayload.description: Decoded JWS payload for kind DeploymentEvidence (not part of the bundle document itself).

evidenceDigest.description: sha256/<base64url> of the canonical snapshot JSON — the value users pin.
